title: Plastic Cabinet - Multipurpose Storage and Organization Cabinet for Household (5 Floors)
bullets: Larger storage space: helps you arrange more items and organized divide into one unit
Better Space Space: the vertical design provides good storage space without taking up a large floor space.
MULTI-USE ORGANIZATION: Suitable for organizing kitchen supplies, bathroom, bedroom, cleaning tools and household items
EASY ACCESS TO CONTENTS: Rotary dividing helps arrange items as per use and reach them quickly.
Practical plastic material:suitable for daily use and easy to clean and keep in order.
desc: Organize your home with ease with this plastic cupboard, designed to provide practical storage space and keep various supplies tidy. The five tiers help to clearly divide and organize items, making it easier to access contents when needed and making better use of vertical space. It can be used in kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, office or any place that needs extra storage space, also suitable for organizing various tools and household items. Practical design and material suitable for daily use, easy to clean and keep things tidy inside the house.
